(2) The boy turns toward the camera, holding a small whiteboard with a yellow border that displays a lyre logo. He holds a black marker and points to the board with a focused, playful expression. A woman's hand briefly enters the frame to touch the whiteboard. (3) The scene cuts back to the piano where the boy is practicing scales. He turns around frequently to interact with the camera, making humorous faces and smiling. The background is a clean, modern studio setting with visible sheet music on the piano stand. (4) The boy stands up and performs an energetic, rhythmic dance in front of the piano. He uses expressive hand gestures and body sways, looking directly at the camera with high energy. The lighting remains bright and consistent. (5) The setting changes to a dimly lit indoor space with purple and orange neon accent lighting. The boy holds a professional black microphone, looking into the lens with a confident, semi-serious expression as if performing.
